title: The visual abstract
caption: The one-page case for counting the level on the C-arm the hospital already owns: the never event, operating-room time, what a wrong level costs, navigation's price, and a per-hospital model with every input labelled.
status: a record, not a final value

source.notes: The whole artifact page, rendered in headless Chromium and captured as one image; its numbers carry its own reference list. Its icons are decoration and are not kept apart. Status set to a record, not a final value on review: The OR-study contradictions confirm a disagreement on where the registry's events occurred (row 9) and on what the fiducial cost means (row 14), and call the navigation absence claims unsourced (row 44).
